name: Gunfire in the Night
description:
Mandragora is in no way impossible to overcome, but our objective is not to defeat her alone. The dark clouds conceal the sun, and the night that follows will be interminably long, but it is fortunate that there remain those who pass on hope. 
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes. 
<Demolition Device> Directly knocks down a Tattered Pillar one tile in front. 
Environmental Conditions: 
Friendly units' HP and ATK are significantly increased, Redeployment Time is reduced, and Starting DP is increased.
